name: Peatling
lore: Cut out of the bank and never carried away. It puts itself back every time the water takes a piece.
prompt: Small squat figure packed together out of wet black peat and fine root hair, glossy with bog water, two pale flat stones set in for eyes, short thick arms held close and the straight cut marks of a turf spade still down its body
